caption: The drawing depicts a small wooden table with a rectangular top, rendered in shades of brown. The table features four evenly spaced, slender, and tapered legs, all colored to match the tabletop. The table has a single drawer at the front center, indicated by a small round keyhole. The perspective view shows the left and front sides of the table, and the background is plain, with a light, almost off-white color and no additional objects or elements present. Some light blue text and a name, "LON CRONK," are visible at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Shaker Candle Table
